covenants.description: Effecting any material change in the management of the Company or shareholding pattern resulting in a possible change in management.
covenants.quote: a. effecting any material change in the management of the Company or shareholding pattern of the Company resulting in a possible change in management;

covenants.description: Intimating the bank prior to availing any fresh loans or facilities from other lenders.
covenants.quote: b. intimating the bank prior to availing any fresh loans or facilities from other lenders;

covenants.description: Diverting funds to group or associate concerns during the tenor of the bank facility.
covenants.quote: c. diverting funds to group or associate concerns during the tenor of the bank facility;

covenants.description: Utilising the facility for any purpose other than for the purposes permitted under the Credit Arrangement Letter and facility documents.
covenants.quote: d. utilising the facility for any purpose other than for the purposes permitted under the Credit Arrangement Letter (“CAL”) and the facility documents;

covenants.description: Creating or permitting to subsist any encumbrance, mortgage, charge, lien or other security interest on assets.
covenants.quote: e. creating or permitting to subsist any encumbrance, mortgage, charge, lien or other security interest on any of the assets of the Company, except as permitted under the facility documents;

covenants.description: Selling, leasing, transferring or otherwise disposing of any assets other than in ordinary course without prior consent.
covenants.quote: f. selling, leasing, transferring or otherwise disposing of any of the assets of the Company, other than in the ordinary course of business, without the prior consent of the bank;

covenants.description: Assigning or transferring rights, benefits or obligations under facility documents without prior written consent.
covenants.quote: g. assigning or transferring all or any of the rights, benefits or obligations of the Company under the CAL or facility documents without the prior written consent of the bank;

covenants.description: Prepaying the outstanding principal amount of the loan prior to due dates without approval.
covenants.quote: h. prepaying the outstanding principal amount of the loan, in whole or in part, prior to the due dates, except with the approval of the lender and subject to such terms and conditions as may be stipulated by the lender

covenants.description: Undertaking or permitting any merger, de-merger, consolidation, reorganisation, scheme of arrangement or amalgamation.
covenants.quote: i. undertaking or permitting any merger, de -merger, consolidation, reorganisation, scheme of arrangement or compromise with creditors or shareholders, including any scheme of amalgamation, reconstruction, creation of any subsidiary or permitting any company to become its subsidiary, without prior consent of the bank;

covenants.description: Permitting any dilution of promoter shareholding during the tenure of the facility without prior approval.
covenants.quote: j. permitting any dilution of promoter shareholding during the tenure of the facility without prior approval of the bank;

covenants.description: Declaring or paying any dividend during subsisting default or event of default.
covenants.quote: k. declaring or paying any dividend, including in cases where there is a subsisting default in debt servicing or upon the occurrence of an event of default, except as permitted in writing by the bank;

covenants.description: Permitting any change in control, shareholding, management and/or constitution of the Company.
covenants.quote: l. permitting any change in control, shareholding, management and/or constitution of the Company without prior approval of the bank;

covenants.description: Effecting any change in the business profile of the Company.
covenants.quote: m. effecting any change in the business profile of the Company without the prior written consent of the bank;

covenants.description: Permitting the amendment of standard form security documents without prior consent.
covenants.quote: n. permitting the amendment of standard form security documents provided by the bank without its prior consent;

covenants.description: Repaying, prepaying, withdrawing unsecured loans from Promoter unless subordinated and prior written consent obtained.
covenants.quote: s. repaying, prepaying, withdrawing or otherwise permitting repayment or withdrawal of any unsecured loans availed from Promoter or their family members, unless such loans are subordinated to the bank debt and prior written consent of the bank has been obtained;

covenants.description: Entering into any borrowing or non-borrowing arrangements beyond RBI limits.
covenants.quote: t. entering into any borrowing or non- borrowing arrangements, whether secured or unsecured, with any bank, financial institution, company, firm or otherwise, or accepting deposits in excess of the limits prescribed by the Reserve Bank of India;

covenants.description: Classification of any borrowing account as special mention account (SMA) or similar category.
covenants.quote: a. classification of any borrowing account of our Company as a special mention account (SMA) or any similar category by any lender in accordance with applicable regulatory guidelines;

covenants.description: Downgrade of credit rating beyond stipulated levels.
covenants.quote: b. downgrade of the credit rating of our Company by any credit rating agency beyond the levels stipulated under the relevant borrowing arrangements, which may result in recall of the facilities or increase in the applicable rate of interest;

covenants.description: Failure or delay in making payment or repayment of principal, interest or other amounts.
covenants.quote: c. failure or delay in making payment or repayment of any principal amount, interest or other amounts payable under the borrowing facilities on their respective due dates;

covenants.description: Default in performance of any covenant, condition, agreement or obligation.
covenants.quote: d. default in performance of any covenant, condition, agreement or obligation under the borrowing arrangements or other related transaction documents;

covenants.description: Initiation of insolvency, bankruptcy, liquidation, winding up, or recovery proceedings.
covenants.quote: e. initiation of, or reasonable apprehension of, any proceedings relating to insolvency, bankruptcy, liquidation, winding up, dissolution or reorganisation of our Company, or appointment of a receiver or liquidator in respect of all or any part of its assets, or initiation of recovery or enforcement proceedings against our Company;

covenants.description: Cessation of business, destruction of assets, or change in business scope causing material adverse effect.
covenants.quote: k. cessation or intended cessation of business, destruction or damage of material assets, or any change in the general nature or scope of business, operations, management or ownership of our Company which could have a material adverse effect;

covenants.description: Governmental or regulatory action affecting business conduct which could have a material adverse effect.
covenants.quote: l. action taken or threatened by any governmental or regulatory authority, including revocation, suspension or non- renewal of licences or authorisations , or imposition of conditions affecting the conduct of business of our Company, which could have a material adverse effect;

covenants.description: Occurrence of event of default under other indebtedness or recall of financial assistance by another lender.
covenants.quote: m. occurrence of an event of default under any other indebtedness of our Company or recall of financial assistance by any other lender;

covenants.description: Occurrence of any event, condition or circumstance, including change in law, having material adverse effect.
covenants.quote: n. occurrence of any event, condition or circumstance, including change in law, which in the opinion of the lender could have a material adverse effect on the business or financial condition of our Company;
